compiled_state.title: Unify PR-comment marker reconstruction: shell delegates to Python (or shared grammar)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: PR comment marker format extended; both writer and reconstruction paths must agree on the grammar.

## Gap Analysis Origin
This task was created from gap analysis finding (taxonomy: state_file_conflict) on story 45da-5043. Without unification, the shell --reconstruct-from-pr regex and the Python reconstruct_from_pr_comments parser will diverge — CI and local paths will produce different ledgers from identical PR-comment fixtures, breaking Step 4.75's parity requirement.

## Implementation Notes
Choose ONE approach and document the rationale:

**Approach A — Shell delegates to Python**:
- Update `plugins/dso/scripts/write-cycle-ledger.sh --reconstruct-from-pr` to invoke `python3 -m dso_ci_review.cycle_ledger reconstruct-from-pr <pr-number> <repo>` (new CLI entry point on cycle_ledger.py)
- Remove the shell-side regex parser
- Add CLI entry point to cycle_ledger.py (if argv[1] == "reconstruct-from-pr": call function, print JSON)

**Approach B — Shared grammar module**:
- Extract the marker regex/grammar into `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/marker_grammar.py`
- Both shell (via python3 -c) and Python (via import) consume it
- Single point of change

Recommended: Approach A (simpler, fewer touch points).

## Parity Test Required
Add `tests/scripts/test_reconstruction_parity.sh`:
- Given: same PR-comment fixture (mocked gh api response)
- When: shell --reconstruct-from-pr and Python reconstruct_from_pr_comments are both invoked
- Then: both produce byte-identical cycle-ledger.json output

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Shell and Python reconstruction produce identical output
  Verify: bash \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test_reconstruction_parity.sh
- [ ] Only one regex/grammar definition exists in the codebase
  Verify: COUNT=\$(grep -lE 'DSO-Review-Cycle.*regex|re\\.compile.*DSO-Review-Cycle' \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/ -r | wc -l); test \$COUNT -le 1

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
